stays_with_person: deciding a job is outside the area
anything said to an upset customer
keeping each tech's licence record true, codes and expiry

provider_block.job: the right person at the right house at the right time

with_us.note: No hosted dispatch step. Office Voice already writes the booked time into ServiceM8 and Simpro, one slot per job with the id back, but only inside a Front Desk call, day or night; a board cannot call it and it reads no licences. When a job slips on the ServiceM8 or Simpro board, its running-late call rings the customer, switched on under Automations. For a board, the write into the job system's schedule and the customer message with consent are quoted as a scoped build.

checks.title: No slot until the address resolves
A licence requirement is a rule read from the record, never assumed
The slot sits inside the customer's window and after the previous job plus travel
One slot per job, written once, updated on a second event
An emergency takes a slot only when a named dispatcher accepts the displacement
The customer is told once per slot, on a channel they consented to
The tech's notification carries the job, the address, the window and what the customer said
A change to the job moves the slot and tells each affected party exactly once
A job that cannot be slotted is escalated with a reason and an owner
Who was assigned, when, by whom or by which rule, and what the customer was told are retrievable by job
